verdict.rationale: Snowflake's marketing page references 'Snowflake CoWork' and 'Snowflake CoCo' as built-in AI assistants ('Ask anything... Build anything...'), and Cortex Analyst lets business users delegate natural-language Q&A tasks without SQL, showing some built-in assistant capability. However, evidence is thin — only marketing taglines for CoWork/CoCo with no detailed documentation of task delegation, and Cortex Analyst is scoped to BI/analytics queries rather than general task delegation. Missing for 10: dedicated product docs for CoWork/CoCo describing task delegation scope, hands-on/independent verification of these assistants in use, and clarity on how broadly tasks (beyond Q&A) can be delegated.
